item.title: Why the USMNT doesn't need a Guardiola-tier manager after Pochettino
item.description: The U.S. men's national team is saying goodbye to Mauricio Pochettino while hoping to attract Pep Guardiola as its next manager. But is a superstar coach what this team really needs?
item.dc:creator: Ryan O'Hanlon

item.title: Who should be the USMNT's coaching candidates to succeed Pochettino?
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino's USMNT tenure ends on Tuesday, so who should U.S. Soccer be eyeing to replace him?
item.dc:creator: Jeff Carlisle and Cesar Hernandez and Lizzy Becherano and Austin Lindberg

item.title: Poch offers Pep advice on USMNT job, calls it 'perfect moment to arrive'
item.description: On the eve of his final game as coach of the United States, Mauricio Pochettino said that if Pep Guardiola asked him about the USMNT job, he'd recommend taking it if given the chance.
item.dc:creator: Jeff Carlisle

item.title: Vinícius Júnior: 'Overwhelmed' by Arsenal transfer interest
item.description: Vinícius Júnior admitted his lacklustre start to the season can be partly attributed to feeling "overwhelmed" at being linked with a move away from Real Madrid in the summer.
item.dc:creator: PA

item.title: Klopp: Nobody 'questioning' Germany after group-winning rout of Dutch
item.description: Germany coach Jürgen Klopp said nobody will be questioning Germany after Florian Wirtz scored twice to help his team book a place in the Nations League quarterfinals.
item.dc:creator: ESPN News Services

item.title: Masked Emi Martínez to return for Argentina after jaw surgery
item.description: Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez will return for Argentina's friendly against Costa Rica on Tuesday after a month on the sidelines due to a gruesome jaw injury.
item.dc:creator: ESPN News Services
